title: Escanor vs Estarossa — 80s Live Action | Seven Deadly Sins
description:
Escanor vs Estarossa, reimagined as an 80s dark fantasy live-action movie.

A message from me:
Your support on the Escanor vs Galand video meant everything to me. I make every one of these videos on my own, from the visuals to the music. Thank you for being part of this journey.


If you'd like to help me get there, you can support me on Patreon. It's never required, just watching means a lot ❤️ https://www.patreon.com/cw/ChapterunknownAI

Follow on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@chapterunknowai

The Lion Sin of Pride faces the Commandment of Love. What if this legendary Seven Deadly Sins fight was filmed as a fantasy movie in the 1980s? Real-looking characters, vintage film texture, and that old-school dark fantasy feel.

Watch Escanor vs Galand: https://youtu.be/UqRqox3Z2V8

Created using AI as an unofficial fan tribute. This is not an official adaptation or trailer.

Which Seven Deadly Sins scene should I turn into an 80s movie next? Tell me in the comments.
